articles.title: UK investigating reports Russian warship fired warning shots near yacht in English Channel
articles.description: BBC News understands the yacht had drifted towards the Admiral Grigorovich, a Russian frigate which has been operating in the Channel.

articles.title: Group planned to attack White House UFC event using snipers and drones, FBI says
articles.description: In newly unsealed court filings, the government says the group allegedly expressed grievances about corruption, the Epstein files, and data centres.

articles.title: Drone strikes in Sudan killed over 1,000 people in five months, says UN
articles.description: More than 1,000 people were killed in drone strikes in Sudan in the first five months of this year, the United Nations has revealed.
